    StartersNew Mexico diner hash brownsCrisp pan-fried potato and onion cakes with sour creamHow to make it800g potatoes1 small onion1 tsp salt80g butter300ml sour cream2 tbsp snipped chivesGrate the potatoes and onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Season well and shape into small flat cakes.Fry in butter over medium heat until deep golden and crisp, in batches, and serve with sour cream and snipped chives.Asgard golden honey wingsCrisp roast wings glazed with honey, garlic and thyme butterHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp salt50g butter4 tbsp honey3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp thyme leavesToss the wings with salt and roast at 220°C until crisp.Melt the butter with the honey, garlic and thyme.Toss the hot wings through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter.Puente Antiguo green chilli quesoThe small desert town in New MexicoHow to make itAs written, serves 4Melted cheddar and cream cheese stirred with roasted green chillies, tomato and onion, served bubbling hot with warm corn chips.Soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter, then add 2 chopped long green chillies and 1 diced tomato and cook 3 minutes.Lower the heat and stir in 250g cream cheese and 100ml milk until smooth, then add 250g grated cheddar a handful at a time until melted.Season with 1 tsp cumin and salt.Pour into a hot dish, top with coriander and serve with 300g corn chips.Blue corn sopaipillas with honey butterDarcy tased him. He's still hungry.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsAsgardian feast beef ribs with roast rootsBeef short ribs roasted 5 hours with carrots, parsnips and potatoes in the juicesHow to make it2kg beef short ribs2 tsp salt2 tsp cracked black pepper4 carrots, cut into chunks3 parsnips, cut into chunks1kg potatoes, cut into chunks1 loaf crusty breadRub the ribs with salt and cracked pepper.Roast covered at 140°C for 4 hours.Add the carrots, parsnips and potatoes to the tray to roast in the juices for the last hour.Serve on a big board with crusty bread.Diner pancake, bacon and egg stackThe diner where Thor eats everything in sightHow to make itAs written, serves 4Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with crisp bacon and fried eggs between the layers, with maple syrup poured over the lot.Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml buttermilk into a thick batter.Cook 12 pancakes in a buttered pan over medium heat, about 2 minutes a side.Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp and fry 4 eggs sunny side up.Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon between the layers and an egg on top, then pour over 125ml maple syrup.SweetsPuente Antiguo churros with hot chocolateFried churros with a cup of thick hot chocolate for dippingHow to make it250ml water30g butter1 tbsp caster sugar, for the dough150g plain flour1 egg1 L vegetable oil100g caster sugar, for rolling2 tsp ground cinnamon150ml cream150g dark chocolate, choppedBoil the water with the butter, sugar and a pinch of salt, then beat in the flour until it forms a ball.Cool for 5 minutes and beat in the egg. Pipe long lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180°C.Fry until golden, then roll in the cinnamon sugar.Heat the cream and pour over the chocolate, stirring smooth, for dipping.DrinksSmashed mug iced coffee floatBrown sugar iced coffee over vanilla ice cream, cold milk and whipped creamHow to make it600ml strong coffee2 tbsp brown sugar8 scoops of vanilla ice cream200ml cold milk150ml cream50g dark chocolate, gratedBrew the coffee, stir in the brown sugar and chill for at least 1 hour.Put the ice cream into four tall glasses, then pour over the coffee and cold milk.Whip the cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate over dark chocolate.
